title: Companions
subtitle: Friends who fight at your side.

quests.title: A Summon Device
description: Every one of Zoni's companions lives in a Summon Device. Craft an empty one from eight amethyst shards around an iron block.
Keep a spare empty device on you once you have companions: if one falls, they go back into it instead of being lost.

quests.title: Choose a Companion
description: At a smithing table, put in a soul lantern, an empty Summon Device and the item that calls the companion you want, then use the device on the spot where they should appear.

Sugar calls Asuna, a dandelion Jean, a cornflower Eugeo, a blue orchid Rain, a cherry sapling Niomus, a note block Bocchi, an iron block Mash, packed ice Eula, soul sand Hu Tao, redstone Arlecchino, a clock Zani, TNT Klee and a golden pickaxe Derek.
Harder to come by: a blaze rod for Astolfo, a diamond sword for Melusine, a wither skeleton skull for Nagako and an end crystal for Jorge.
Each has a gift of their own: Bocchi gives allies regeneration, Mash shrugs off blows and draws enemies in, Eugeo roots foes in place, Jean throws them into the air.

quests.title: Companion Pendant
description: Craft a Companion Pendant from four gold ingots, four red dye and a heart of the sea. Use it on a companion to make them stay put, or follow you again.
To put a companion away, gear and all, shift-right-click them holding an empty Summon Device.

quests.title: Recover Pills
description: A golden apple ringed with four sugar makes four Recover Pills. Use them to heal your companions.
Companions can be given weapons and armour to fight with, and better gear means fewer pills.

quests.title: Advanced Summon Device
description: At a smithing table, a netherite upgrade template, an empty Summon Device and a totem of undying make an Advanced Summon Device.
Shift-right-click one of your own tamed pets with it to carry them, with their gear, wherever you go. Use it again to let them out.

quests.title: Befriend an Amigo
description: Amigos roam the wild: Claymore in forests and taiga, Wavelyn in plains and birch forests, Cocogoat in hills and mountains, Pollypounce on beaches, Shybroom in green plains.
Right-click one and it tells you what it likes (Claymore cooked salmon, Wavelyn cookies, Cocogoat azure bluets, Pollypounce cod, Shybroom cooked chicken).
Give it its favourite until its health and tolerance are full, then keep giving: each gift after that has a 1 in 4 chance to win it over.
A wild amigo you walk away from can vanish the way monsters do. A befriended one never does.

quests.title: The Amigo's Backpack
description: Right-click your amigo to open its backpack. Give it armour there, and set how it behaves: follow you or stay, wander or not, attack every hostile or only your targets, defend just you or your whole team.
Amigos level up from the foes they defeat, and every level makes them stronger. Their favourite food heals them when they're hurt.

quests.title: A Keepsake
description: If your amigo falls, a Keepsake of them comes to you (or waits until you next log in). Their backpack spills where they fell, so go back for it.
After a day's rest (20 minutes of play), use the keepsake on the ground and your amigo comes back at full health, with its name, level and settings.
